reuse.why: Replaces five local midpoint copies (updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule, preview, forecast, budget template) with one shared function and reuses getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance, but adds getExpectedAmount next to the existing getScheduledAmount instead of evolving that one helper.

duplication.why: The rule now exists once; residual redundancy is the preview site's own null ternary around a function that already handles null, and two overlapping entry points.

placement.why: Rule lives in shared/schedules.ts; the API field is produced in scheduleModel.toExternal with a named result type in api-models.ts.

scope.why: All edits serve the four steps: consolidating amount sites, the API field and tests.

maintainability.why: Two exported functions (getExpectedAmount, and getScheduledAmount with op appended after inverse) mean the desktop-client callers of getScheduledAmount silently skip the approximate rule, and several new comments still say 'furthest from zero' after step 4 changed the rule.

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount gains a trailing op parameter and delegates to a new parallel getExpectedAmount with an isapprox branch; computeSchedulePreviewTransactions keeps its own null check around the call, and desktop-client callers of getScheduledAmount do not pass op.
